caller: Yahi toh problem hai sir, dark web par aapke saare personal photos aur bank details leak ho chuke hain.

caller: Jaldi kariye sir, waqt bahut kam hai, agar hacker ne password change kar diya toh aap kuch nahi kar paayenge.
caller: App open karke jo 9 digit ka ID number aa raha hai screen par, woh mujhe bataiye.

caller: Main check kar raha hoon aapki security settings. Arre sir, aapke Paytm aur Google Pay mein toh illegal transactions dikh rahe hain!
caller: Cyber police abhi aapke ghar aane wali hai arrest karne, kyunki yeh saare transactions aapke naam par hue hain.
caller: Bachna hai toh government verification gateway par ek security deposit jama karna hoga taaki case dismiss ho sake.

victim: Haan beta, Ramesh bol raha hoon. Kya baat hui? Microsoft se kyun call aaya hai?
caller: Sir bohot urgent situation hai. Aapke computer aur registered mobile se massive Trojan virus attack trigger hua hai Lucknow server par. Agle 10 minute mein fix nahi hua toh pura phone aur bank hack ho jayega.
victim: Arrey baap re! Yeh kaise ho gaya beta? Maine toh kal bas pension ki slip download ki thi net se.
caller: Wahi se virus enter hua hai sir. Hackers aapka screen aur net banking session mirror kar rahe hain. Aap turant call par bane rahiye, call galti se bhi mat kaatna.
victim: Haan haan beta main call par hi hoon. Batao main kya karun? Main toh bohot ghabra gaya hoon.
caller: Ghabraiye mat, main guide kar raha hoon. Turant phone mein Play Store kholiye aur AnyDesk app search karke install kijiye.
victim: Ruko beta, chashma pehan loon... haan Play Store khol liya... AnyDesk likha hai... ek red color ka icon aa raha hai.
caller: Haan wahi hai sir! Fast download par click kijiye. Der mat kijiye, hackers files corrupt kar rahe hain!
victim: Haan download ho gaya beta... ab open kiya toh yahan 9 digit ka code aa raha hai screen par.
caller: Woh 9 digit ka security key turant mujhe batayein taaki hamara server aapke phone ko secure shield provide kar sake.
victim: Haan likho beta... 482... 910... 335.
caller: Theek hai, ab screen par Allow aur Start Now ka popup aayega, bina padhe turant accept kijiye, jaldi!
victim: Daba diya beta... par yeh phone ki screen apne aap kyun hil rahi hai? Apps apne aap khul rahe hain!
caller: Yeh hamara automated cyber antivirus chal raha hai sir. Kisi aur ko phone mat dikhaiye aur kisi family member ko mat batana abhi, scanning interrupt ho jayegi.
victim: Lekin beta screen par mera SBI YONO khul gaya hai... bank app kyun check kar raha hai scan?
caller: Sir hackers SBI app par target kar rahe hain! Security breach block karne ke liye ek one-time clearance token generate hua hai SMS mein. Jaldi 6 digit ka number boliye!
victim: SMS toh aaya hai beta... par likha hai OTP for transaction of 45000 rupees... beta yeh toh paise katne ka lag raha hai?
caller: Arrey sir yeh demo security token hai! Yeh paise nahi katenge, agar 30 second mein OTP nahi diya toh account cyber cell freeze kar dega aur police investigation shuru ho jayegi!
victim: Police investigation? Nahi nahi beta main toh retired headmaster hoon! OTP note karo... 729144.
caller: Theek hai token feed ho raha hai. Par virus ne fixed deposit link par bhi strike kiya hai. Dusra OTP turant aayega, bina deri kiye batayein!
victim: Beta mere phone par message aaya ki 45000 debited! Yeh toh sach mein paise kat gaye mere account se!
caller: Sir woh RBI safe escrow server mein temporary move huye hain protection ke liye! 10 minute mein wapas aa jayenge 100% guaranteed. Dusra OTP boliye warna FD break ho jayegi!
victim: Beta main ek baar Hazratganj branch jaake branch manager se baat kar loon? Paas mein hi hai.
caller: Bilkul branch nahi jana sir! Branch staff unauthorized hota hai cyber cases mein. Agar branch gaye toh hacker ko hint mil jayega aur bacha hua balance zero ho jayega. Line par rahiye!
victim: Acha acha theek hai... dusra OTP aaya hai 550921... jaldi bacha lijiye mere paise.
caller: Ho gaya secure. Ab last validation step ke liye Google Pay kholiye aur RBI verification UPI ID par 25000 ka refundable security balance bhejiye.

victim: Haan pranaam beta. Geeta hi bol rahi hoon. Kaun bol rahe ho aap?
caller: Aunty main Swaroop Nagar Kanpur se Dr. Rastogi Eye Care Clinic se baat kar raha hoon, mera naam Amit Verma hai.
victim: Dr. Rastogi... beta mere bete ka naam bhi Amit hai, par mujhe aankh ke doctor ke baare mein kuch pata nahi tha. Kyun phone kiya aapne?
caller: Aunty ji, aapke bete Amit ji ne kal clinic aakar aapke motiyabind ke routine checkup ke liye Friday dopahar 3 baje ka time liya tha.
victim: Achha! Haan Amit keh raha tha ki maaji aapko door ka dhundhla dikhta hai toh Kanpur le chalke check karwayenge. Par beta Friday ko toh meri ekadashi ka vrat hai.
caller: Aunty checkup mein koi khane-peene par rok nahi hoti, bas aankh mein dawa dal kar parda check karte hain. Par agar aapko kamzori lage toh Saturday ka kar dein?
victim: Haan beta, Saturday dopahar ya subah ka kar do toh achha rahega. Par suno, wo aankh mein drop daalte hain toh jalan toh nahi hoti?
caller: Halka sa do second ke liye lagta hai aunty, phir theek ho jata hai. Bas aadhe ghante ke liye dhoop mein roshni tez lagti hai, isliye kaala chashma sath le aayiyega.
victim: Achha kaala chashma... theek hai. Aur beta koi phone pe form toh nahi bharna padega? Woh padosi bolte hain phone pe koi message aaye toh dhyan se dekhna.
caller: Aapke padosi bilkul sahi kehte hain aunty. Hum log phone par koi form ya link nahi bharwate. Aap seedhe bete ke sath clinic aayiyega, entry seedhe register mein hogi.
victim: Chalo theek hai. Par fees kitni lagegi beta? Kahin Amit ne pehle se online toh nahi de di? Mujhe hisab nahi maloom rehta.
caller: Nahi ma'am, online koi advance nahi liya gaya hai. Consultation fee 400 rupaye hai, jab aap Saturday ko aayengi tab counter pe de dijiyega.
victim: Achha beta, Saturday ko kitne baje aana hoga?
caller: Saturday ko dopahar 12 baje ka slot khali hai. Kya 12 baje theek rahega aapke liye?
victim: Haan 12 baje theek hai beta. Dhoop tez hone se pehle pohoch jayenge. Hospital kahan padega Swaroop Nagar mein?
caller: Aunty Swaroop Nagar mein jo Madhuraj hospital ke paas wali gali hai, wahi corner par Dr. Rastogi Eye Center hai.
victim: Achha Madhuraj ke paas... theek hai, Amit ko pata hoga rasta. Wo mujhe gaadi se le aayega.
caller: Haan ji, kisi ke sath hi aayiyega kyunki drop dalne ke baad 2 ghante khud gaadi ya chalne mein thoda sahara lagta hai.
victim: Haan beta, mere ghutne mein bhi thoda rehta hai, Amit hi sath rahega. Par beta agar koi emergency ho ya Amit ko chhutti na mile toh?
caller: Koi pareshani nahi aunty ji. Agar koi dikkat ho toh clinic ke landline number par subah call karke bata dijiyega, hum next week reschedule kar denge.
